DamageMeter.name: 皮皮统计: Skada
DamageMeter.changelog: 兼容 v0.105 CombatState 接口变更
changelog_detail: 修复 STS2 v0.105.0 将 Creature.CombatState 从 CombatState 改为 ICombatState 后，末日击杀与持续伤害归因路径可能触发的兼容问题。
DamageMeter 接入共享 Sts2Compat 运行时桥，同一 DLL 继续支持 v0.103.2 正式服与 v0.105.0 测试服。
玩家列表读取增加反射回退，助攻、中毒、末日等归因逻辑在新旧 CombatState 形态下保持安全。
changelog_detail_en: Fixes the STS2 v0.105.0 Creature.CombatState return-type change from CombatState to ICombatState for Doom kill and power-damage attribution paths.
Source-links the shared Sts2Compat runtime bridge into DamageMeter so one DLL continues to run on v0.103.2 stable and v0.105.0 beta.
Adds a reflection fallback for the combat Players collection, keeping assist, poison, and Doom attribution logic version-safe.

SpeedX.name: 皮皮极速: SpeedX
SpeedX.changelog: 修复 v0.105.0 奖励界面改动导致 SpeedX 失效
changelog_detail: 修复 v0.105.0 删除 NRewardsScreen.SetRewards、把奖励按钮生成移动到 _Ready 后，SpeedX 在 Harmony PatchAll 阶段失败的问题。
自动拾取会在 v0.103.2 上继续挂 SetRewards，在 v0.105.0 上自动改挂 _Ready，从而恢复整体倍速/跳动画等补丁初始化。
继续保持 v0.103.2/v0.105.0 单 DLL 兼容构建，并通过 IL 静态兼容检查。
SpeedX.changelog_en: Restore SpeedX on STS2 v0.105.0 rewards screen changes
changelog_detail_en: Fixes SpeedX failing during Harmony PatchAll on v0.105.0 because NRewardsScreen.SetRewards was removed and reward setup moved into _Ready.
Auto-loot now targets SetRewards on v0.103.2 or _Ready on v0.105.0, restoring global speed/skip patches after startup.
Keeps the v0.103.2/v0.105.0 single-DLL compatibility build and passes the static IL compatibility guard.

RemoveMultiplayerPlayerLimit.name: Remove Multiplayer Player Limit
RemoveMultiplayerPlayerLimit.changelog: 适配 v0.99 beta 新 mod 结构
changelog_detail: 新增 v0.99 格式 manifest（外部 JSON + id + affects_gameplay）
多人联机 API 无破坏性变更，Harmony patches 全部兼容

Rewind.name: 皮皮倒带: Rewind
Rewind.changelog: 增强 v0.105 读档继续追踪兼容性
changelog_detail: 将倒带的继续游戏/读档追踪改为运行时解析 RunManager.SetUpSavedSinglePlayer，同时覆盖 v0.103.2 的 void 签名与 v0.105.0 的 Task 返回签名，保持单 DLL 双版本可用。
重新审计 Rewind 直接触达的 STS2 方法引用；在已有选牌器与 PowerCmd 兼容桥之后，没有发现剩余的直接调用签名不匹配。
稳定服 v0.103.2 与测试服 v0.105.0 下，reload 统计和外部读档检测 patch 都会继续生效。
Rewind.changelog_en: Harden save-continue tracking for STS2 v0.105
changelog_detail_en: Updates the Rewind continue/reload tracker to resolve RunManager.SetUpSavedSinglePlayer at runtime, covering the v0.103.2 void signature and the v0.105.0 Task-returning signature with one DLL.

Re-audits Rewind's direct STS2 method references against the v0.105.0 assembly; no remaining direct call signature mismatches were found after the existing selector and PowerCmd compatibility bridges.
Keeps the reload statistics and external-reload detection patch active on both the stable v0.103.2 branch and the v0.105.0 beta branch.

ModConfig.name: 皮皮配置: ModConfig
ModConfig.changelog: 重新打包发布 zip，移除 legacy mod_manifest.json 修复游戏菜单里的重复模组条目
changelog_detail: 游戏 v0.99+ 起 <ModId>.json 是唯一的外部 root manifest，但 mod loader 依然会扫描 legacy mod_manifest.json —— 同目录两份 manifest 会被 loader 各自注册为独立模组条目，游戏菜单里就出现同名的红色「已加载」坏条目。
上一版发布 zip 里同时带了两份 manifest。虽然 ModManager.ps1 安装/更新时会调用 Remove-LegacyExternalManifest 清理玩家目录，但 zip 里还带着 mod_manifest.json，紧跟的 Copy-Item 又把它复制回来，等于白清理。
本版重新打包的 zip 只含 <Mod>.json + DLL + PCK，不含 mod_manifest.json。没有代码变更。从上一版更新过来时，ModManager 会删掉玩家目录里残留的 mod_manifest.json，重复条目消失。
ModConfig.changelog_en: repackage release zip without legacy mod_manifest.json to fix duplicate mod entry in game menu
changelog_detail_en: Game v0.99+ introduced <ModId>.json as the sole external root manifest. The mod loader still scans for legacy mod_manifest.json - so when a deployed folder contains both, the loader registers them as two separate mod entries and the game menu shows a duplicate red 'already loaded' row for that mod.

Releases up to and including the previous version shipped both manifests in the zip. Even though ModManager.ps1's install/update path calls Remove-LegacyExternalManifest to clean the target directory, the cleanup was undone because the zip still contained mod_manifest.json and the subsequent Copy-Item step re-deposited it.

This release ships a repackaged zip that contains only <Mod>.json + DLL + PCK. No code changes. Updating from the previous version will trigger ModManager to remove the old mod_manifest.json from the player's game folder and the duplicate entry disappears.

QuickLink.name: 皮皮快连: QuickLink
QuickLink.changelog: 恢复 v0.105 测试版战斗回退兼容性
changelog_detail: STS2 v0.104+ 把 RunManager.SetUpSavedMultiPlayer 从 void 改成 async Task；房主载入时 Harmony Postfix 可能会在新的 CombatStateSynchronizer 创建前就执行。
在 NGame.LoadRun 入口再次执行 QuickLink 的战斗同步绕过，此时多人存档 setup 已完整 await 完成，可避免 v0.105 房主战斗回退卡在 CombatStateSynchronizer.WaitForSync。
保持 v0.103.2 路径不变：旧版上的 SetUpSavedMultiPlayer Postfix 仍然生效；若同步器已经被禁用，LoadRun 兜底只会跳过。
QuickLink.changelog_en: Restore v0.105 beta combat rewind compatibility
changelog_detail_en: STS2 v0.104+ changed RunManager.SetUpSavedMultiPlayer from void to async Task; on host load, Harmony postfixes can run before the new CombatStateSynchronizer is created.

Repeat QuickLink's combat-sync bypass from NGame.LoadRun, after saved multiplayer setup has been fully awaited, so host combat rewind no longer stalls at CombatStateSynchronizer.WaitForSync on v0.105.
Keep the existing v0.103.2 path intact: the earlier SetUpSavedMultiPlayer postfix still works there, and the LoadRun safety pass is a no-op when the synchronizer is already disabled.
